def Mf.DP.ClassicalSubsamplingAppendixFeasible : ClassicalSubsamplingAppendixState → Prop :=
fun S =>
  S.alpha = S.p * S.alphaIncluded + (1 - S.p) * S.alphaExcluded ∧
    S.beta = S.p * S.betaIncluded + (1 - S.p) * S.betaExcluded ∧
      S.alphaExcluded + S.betaExcluded = 1 ∧
        S.betaIncluded ≥ S.k * S.alphaIncluded + S.b ∧ S.betaIncluded ≥ S.k * S.alphaExcluded + S.b
